scope: s 3(1) (child, next of kin, regenerative and nonregenerative tissue, senior available next of kin), ss 8, 9, 11-20, 22(1)-(5), 23(1), (2), 24(1), (1A), (1B), (2), (3), 24A(1), (2), 29, 29A(2)-(4) (s 29A(4)(b)-(f), ss 29C, 29D, 29E as single facts), 34
seat: the potential donor (living, and after death) and the senior available next of kin

roles: I may give tissue or blood, or want to know what happens to my body after I die
I am next of kin of a person who has died, or may soon die
I am the parent or guardian of a child under 18 who may give tissue or blood

situation_parameters.name: I have signed a consent to give tissue or blood while I am alive
situation_parameters.description: Whether you have signed a consent under Part 2 to the removal of tissue or blood from your body while you are alive
situation_parameters.role: I may give tissue or blood, or want to know what happens to my body after I die
questions: May my tissue be removed now under the consent I signed

situation_parameters.name: the person is kept breathing by artificial means
situation_parameters.description: Whether the person's respiration and the circulation of their blood are being maintained by artificial means (s 24(2))
situation_parameters.role: I am next of kin of a person who has died, or may soon die
questions: Have the brain-death declarations been made about the person

situation_parameters.name: I made my consent known while the person was unconscious, before death
situation_parameters.description: Whether, as the senior available next of kin, you told the designated officer you consent while the person was unconscious and had not yet died (s 22(4))
situation_parameters.role: I am next of kin of a person who has died, or may soon die
questions: May the officer act on the consent I gave while the person was unconscious
